title: Comprehensive IP-Based CCTV Surveillance Network for Puducherry Coastal Boulevard
summary: Fictional case: Installation of 42 high-definition PTZ and fixed night-vision CCTV cameras along the Goubert Avenue and Rock Beach promenade to enhance tourist safety and deter night-time anti-social activity.
problemStatement: Inadequate optical surveillance along the 2.5 km coastal promenade leading to blind spots during peak tourist gatherings and festival celebrations.
decisionReason: Sanctioned subject to reducing secondary redundant PTZ poles and integrating fiber backbone with the Central Police Control Room (PCR). Standardized vendor AMC warranty of 3 years mandatory.
implementationOutcome: Successfully deployed 38 cameras by December 2023. Real-time video feed streams to Police Command Center. Resulted in 34% faster incident response times during 2024 New Year celebrations.

title: Solar-Powered Standalone Wireless Surveillance Cameras for Rural Police Outposts
summary: Fictional case: Procurement of 20 standalone 4G solar-powered surveillance nodes for peripheral rural border checkposts with limited grid electrical stability.
problemStatement: Frequent power outages in outlying rural jurisdictions incapacitate legacy analog wired CCTV recording units.
decisionReason: Rejected due to recurring 4G SIM bandwidth operational expenditure recurring costs, battery degradation issues noted in coastal high-humidity environment, and lack of localized service centers for the proposed vendor.
implementationOutcome: Not implemented. Recommendation issued to explore unified fiber leasing with municipal utility instead.

title: Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) and Red-Light Violation Detection System
summary: Fictional case: Deployment of 28 ANPR smart optical cameras across 7 major arterial traffic junctions along Anna Salai and 100 Feet Road.
problemStatement: Manual enforcement of traffic signal violations and stolen vehicle tracking is labor intensive and causes intersection congestion.
decisionReason: Approved with modifications: Phased rollout starting with top 4 high-density intersections. System must connect to National VAHAN database API.
implementationOutcome: Phase 1 operational. Over 1,200 automated e-challans generated in Q1 2025. Stolen motorcycle detection accuracy achieved 91.4% in trial audit.

title: Facial Recognition CCTV Camera Pilot for Heritage Town Market Areas
summary: Fictional case: Pilot installation of 15 advanced facial recognition biometric CCTV cameras in crowded Sunday Market and Nehru Street shopping district.
problemStatement: High density petty theft, pickpocketing, and crowded festival crowd management challenges in narrow commercial corridors.
decisionReason: Live automated facial recognition held in abeyance pending statutory data protection and SOP guidelines. Sanctioned only for ultra-high-definition optical recording without active automated biometrics matching.
implementationOutcome: Optical recording cameras deployed; biometric software withheld as per compliance directive.

title: CCTV Infrastructure Upgrade and Storage Redundancy for Central Police Station
summary: Fictional case: Upgrading 16 internal and perimeter custody cameras at Central Police Station with 60-day tamper-proof cloud/SAN storage.
problemStatement: Legacy DVR storage capacity is limited to 14 days, risking non-compliance with statutory judicial guidelines requiring 30-60 day retention of station records.
decisionReason: Mandatory compliance with supreme court / judicial custody monitoring standards. Sanctioned with high priority.
implementationOutcome: SAN storage racks delivered and 12 cameras migrated. Final commissioning and audit inspection scheduled for end of month.

title: Mobile Drone-Mounted High Zoom Surveillance for Coastal Patrol
summary: Fictional case: Procurement of 3 tethered and untethered aerial surveillance drones equipped with thermal and optical cameras for night coastal monitoring.
problemStatement: Difficulties in inspecting coastal sandbar smuggling and illegal nighttime landing spots with static land-based cameras.
decisionReason: Currently undergoing inter-departmental technical committee review regarding pilot flight clearance and DGCA compliance.

title: Legacy Proposal: Community CCTV Integration Scheme (Incomplete Evidence Case)
summary: Fictional case: Proposal to subsidize private shopkeeper CCTV cameras facing public streets in exchange for departmental feed access.
problemStatement: Scattered commercial establishments have private cameras but standard definitions, storage intervals, and legal consent agreements are undocumented.
decisionReason: File closed without financial sanction due to unresolved privacy indemnification terms and absence of vendor standard specifications.
implementationOutcome: No implementation recorded in departmental archives.
